summary: Validated 4 surgical frontend fixes via live Playwright tests against the preview URL with admin user (earauzt@gmail.com). All 4 fixes verified working in DOM. No regressions detected in adjacent tabs.

regression_save_state_preserved.details: PresupuestoEditable.js still maintains incomeProjection state (lines 41-45) and posts it inside handleSaveBudget POST /api/budget/personal payload (line 89-95). Save flow intact.

Deudas.js BANKS array still includes 'apple' (Apple Card USA) — if Apple Card was intentionally removed for this admin, consider removing the option from BANKS too, or document why it stays for other users.
